page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-96-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 756.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. For high-speed local storage, the instance includes 22,549 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity, distributed across 6 local SSD devices. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server configuration is designed for workloads requiring substantial local storage capacity alongside significant memory and processing resources. The high density of dedicated vCPUs and the large NVMe SSD storage array make it suitable for large-scale database deployments, data warehousing, and intensive transactional processing. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile balances massive local storage capacity with a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, reducing the need for external storage attachments for I/O-heavy operations. Appropriate workloads include distributed databases, big data analytics, and high-throughput storage-bound applications.
